name: One model version

input.query: SELECT json_build_object(  'id', m.id, 'owner', u.handle, 'game', g.slug, 'version', m.version,  'repo', m.repo, 'release_tag', m.release_tag, 'commit_sha', m.commit_sha,  'class', m.weight_class, 'size_bytes', m.size_bytes,  'param_count', m.param_count, 'status', m.status,  'reject_reason', m.reject_reason, 'created_at', m.created_at,  'ratings', coalesce((SELECT json_object_agg(r.ladder, json_build_object(       'rating', r.conservative, 'provisional', r.matches_played < 20,       'matches', r.matches_played))     FROM ratings r WHERE r.model_id = m.id), '{}'::json))::text AS body FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id WHERE m.id = ($1)::uuid

description: The body column is cast to text and parsed back by a parse_json task: Orion's db_read goes through sqlx's Any driver, which cannot decode the Postgres json/jsonb type and fails the task outright. Casting keeps response construction in SQL -- see README 'Postgres builds the response JSON' -- at the cost of one extra task.
